trigger: principal: 'it feels like we aren't finding good setups anymore — why?' then 'point a generator at where the money actually came from'

diagnosis.cause_1_wrong_pond: 94% of the book's unrealized gain came from TEN names — HUBS +7.4k, GCT +5.4k, DFIN +5.4k, CTSH +2.5k, SAP +1.9k, BRBY +1.9k, MNDY +1.7k, KNSL +1.3k, G +1.3k, HRTG +0.9k — all software, services, insurance, brands. ALL FOURTEEN names courted this session were 0.5-0.9x book industrials, distributors, banks and retailers. Every generator built this cycle (EDINET, Euronext shelf, bank consolidation, deep value) is a CHEAPNESS screen. We industrialised the search for a category that produced zero of our returns.
diagnosis.cause_2_ratchet: TEN new disqualifying gates were added in ~24h (mix regression, pension adjustment, durability guard, takeout math, window-anchoring, touch-vs-terminal, strict denominator, PFIC-on-drawdown, quiet-period, dedup). Each individually correct; collectively a MONOTONIC RATCHET - every gate removes candidates, none admits any. At ~15% rejection each, ten gates cut a 50% pass rate to 10%. Zero passes in 14 courts is what a ratchet looks like from inside, and it is INDISTINGUISHABLE from 'the market is expensive' unless tested.
diagnosis.cause_3_fair_market: SPY +6.6% since May near highs; genuinely fewer cheap things. Real - but the most comfortable explanation and the one most likely to be accepted without evidence.

THE_CALIBRATION_FINDING.method: pulled 3-year price history for the nine winners and compared ENTRY price to each name's OWN 3-year high
THE_CALIBRATION_FINDING.interpretation: the winners were NOT cheap on assets - they were quality businesses bought at a deep discount to their OWN valuation history. A pattern no book-value screen can express, and the reason our entire generator stack was structurally blind to it.

generator_built.criteria: drawdown 35-78% from own 3y high | gross margin >=35% | revenue CAGR >= -2% | net debt/EBITDA <=3.5 | cap >=$400M | basing flag
generator_built.explicitly_excluded: book value is consulted NOWHERE - a name at 6x sales can pass
generator_built.scoring: proximity to the winners' -46% median depth (0.35) + quality (0.30) + growth (0.20) + basing (0.15)
generator_built.first_test_pass: 60-name subset returned ARM (-46% dd, 98% gm, score 99.7), PLTR (-39%, 84%, 95.0), NFLX (-45%, 49%, 87.2) - the signature reproduces

still_owed: BLUE-TEAM the rejections: take CHRW 5/10, SFPI 5/10, Cleanup 5/10 and argue the other side with red-team rigour. If none moves, the bar is calibrated; if two of three flip, the ratchet is the problem.

BACK-TEST every gate added this session against the winners: would the mix-regression gate have rejected DFIN? would the durability guard have killed BRBY? Any gate that blocks our best positions is overfitted to the failure that birthed it - the detector-composition lesson applied to ourselves.

FULL_RUN_RESULT_20260803.VALIDATION: the screen independently surfaced THREE names we already hold - NOW, ONON, SAP - without being told about them. It is finding our own kind, which is the point and the cleanest evidence the calibration is real rather than curve-fit.
FULL_RUN_RESULT_20260803.CONTRAST_WITH_THE_VALUE_STACK: 67 candidates in one pass versus zero passing courts from fourteen deep-value names. That gap is the diagnosis confirmed: the drought was the pond, not the market.
FULL_RUN_RESULT_20260803.IMMEDIATE_TENSION_TO_COURT_HONESTLY: a quarter of this slate IS the AI complex (ARM, PLTR, NOW, PATH, APP) against a frozen AI-BREAK call at p=0.45 for end-2027. The screen is doing its job; the board's job is to say whether a 40-50% de-rate in those names is the market already pricing the break, or the entry the ensemble says to refuse. That is a REAL conflict between two house views and must be adjudicated, not averaged.
next_actions: court the top of the slate in a fresh session with agent budget - start with the non-AI names (PINS, AEM, TCOM, ISRG, BSX, DSGX, APPF) so the AI-conflict does not contaminate the first read
then court ARM/PLTR explicitly AS the AI-break conflict case
blue-team the three 5/10 value rejections (CHRW, SFPI, Cleanup) to test the ratchet
back-test each new gate against the nine winners
